aiResearchSummary.text: Qolo is focused on enhancing large-scale transaction systems through the development of an Intelligent Wire Transfer Automation System. This system streamlines payments by utilizing pseudo and provisional accounts to manage and mark invoices as paid upon successful matching. The innovation aims to refine the payment process for businesses, aligning with Qolo's mission to facilitate payments and reduce expenses.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $24,380,597 to $153,658,444, a 6.3x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 75 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
